🧠 思考过程 / 翻译追溯
────────────────────────────────
【意图解析】
  风格：交响曲乐章
  情绪：宏大, 庄严, 戏剧性, 昂扬
  速度：♩=104   调式：major   拍号：4/4   曲式：['Introduction', 'Exposition-Primary', 'Exposition-Secondary', 'Development', 'Recapitulation', 'Coda']   小节：32
【风格硬约束（本地执行）】
  ✔ accompaniment pattern 'sustained' → broken_arpeggio
  ✔ accompaniment pattern 'block_chords' → broken_arpeggio
  ✔ accompaniment pattern 'octave_pulse' → broken_arpeggio
  ✔ accompaniment pattern 'block_chords' → broken_arpeggio
【翻译推理（LLM）】
  识别为交响曲乐章（plan.genre=classical/symphony），C 大调 4/4，32 小节奏鸣曲式六段。采用 plan 明确速度 84/104/126/132/118/100，编制用 plan.instrumentation 12 声部并 solo_instrument=violin 让第一小提琴主奏。各段按 brief 指定和声与织体：引子 I–V sparse+sustained、主部 I–vi–IV–V7 driving+arch、副部转属调 G 大调 flowing+arch、展开转关系小调 a 小调 fragmented、再现回归 C 大调 flowing+descending、尾声 driving 后 cadence(2)。高潮段展开加 thicken，末尾显式 narrative(appearances=false) 关闭动机变形以保持旋律形态，最后 finalize。
【调用的脚本】
  new_score(♩=104, 4/4, voices=12)
  set_sections([Introduction(4)/Exposition-Primary(6)/Exposition-Secondary(5)/Development(8)/Recapitulation(5)/Coda(4)])
  set_harmony(Introduction, progression=['I', 'V'])
  accompaniment(Introduction, pattern=broken_arpeggio, register=low, density=0.5)
  melody(Introduction, register=high, rhythm=sparse, contour=arch)
  set_harmony(Exposition-Primary, progression=['I', 'vi', 'IV', 'V7'])
  accompaniment(Exposition-Primary, pattern=broken_arpeggio, register=low, density=1)
  melody(Exposition-Primary, register=high, rhythm=driving, contour=arch)
  set_harmony(Exposition-Secondary, progression=['I', 'V7', 'I', 'IV', 'V7'], key_sharps=1, mode=major)
  accompaniment(Exposition-Secondary, pattern=broken_arpeggio, register=low, density=1)
  melody(Exposition-Secondary, register=high, rhythm=flowing, contour=arch)
  set_harmony(Development, progression=['i', 'iv', 'V7', 'i'], key_sharps=0, mode=minor)
  accompaniment(Development, pattern=broken_arpeggio, register=low, density=2)
  melody(Development, register=high, rhythm=fragmented, contour=wave)
  thicken(Development)
  set_harmony(Recapitulation, progression=['I', 'vi', 'IV', 'V7'])
  accompaniment(Recapitulation, pattern=broken_arpeggio, register=low, density=1)
  melody(Recapitulation, register=high, rhythm=flowing, contour=descending)
  set_harmony(Coda, progression=['IV', 'I', 'ii', 'V7'])
  accompaniment(Coda, pattern=broken_arpeggio, register=low, density=2)
  melody(Coda, register=high, rhythm=driving, contour=ascending)
  cadence(Coda, bars=2)
  narrative(appearances=False)
  finalize

score_spec.title: 苍穹
score_spec.notes: 《苍穹》为C大调单乐章交响序曲，32小节，4/4拍。结构：1-8引子（Maestoso，pp，长音持续，弦乐低吟，木管呼应，庄严四度动机首次呈示）；9-16主部（Allegro，mf，第一小提琴奏出号角式主题，级进填充，木管与铜管支声）；17-24展开（Agitato，ff，动机碎裂、切分与半音下行，全奏高潮）；25-32再现与尾声（Tempo I，f→p，主题回归主调，完全终止于C大调主和弦）。全曲遵循功能性和声，声部间避免平行五度，各乐器组分层接力，以定音鼓与低音弦乐奠定根基。

A **风格目录（仅已学包）** is injected at the end of this system prompt. Use it to set `genre_id`.
已学 = 有 `grammar.yaml`（/learn-grammar）；旧 style_contract 不进目录。
